summary: Describes a framework for keeping media confidential and intact end to end in switched conferencing, where the media distributors in the middle are not trusted with encryption keys. It builds on existing security mechanisms. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: In a group call, a server forwards everyone's video. This document shows how to seal the video so even the server passing it along cannot peek inside.

questions: how to make conferencing end to end encrypted
